author: Nintendo of America
description:
Join Warframe today on Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/warframe-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1057-01&utm_id=P1057-01 

There are 85M+ registered players in Warframe, a cooperative, free-to-play third-person looter shooter set in a constantly evolving sci-fi universe. The fate of the Origin System is in your hands, Tenno—and it's never looked this good! Bullet-jump at 60 FPS and in 1080p resolution, whether docked or in handheld mode. Expect faster load times, smoother movement and optimized controls, including right-handed Joy-Con 2 mouse support. Significant visual improvements like variable refresh rate, local reflections, sun shadows, higher resolution textures and more have also been added.  

Log in before April 15, 2026 to receive a FREE Ambimanus Pack, which includes: 
- Vericres Warfan (including Weapon Slot + Orokin Catalyst) 
- Akomeogi Warfan Skin 
- Slicing Feathers Stance Mod 
- 3-Day Affinity Booster  
- 3-Day Cre
title: Warframe – Now Available – Nintendo Switch 2

author: Nintendo of America
description:
The Eternal Life of Goldman is coming to Nintendo Switch in 2026! 

This may look like every other platformer at first glance—satisfying skills, memorable boss fights, and hand-drawn landscapes that belong in a gallery. But look closer, and you'll see our hero is a statistical outlier. His age, his "particular set of skills," and his choice of weaponry make him stand out from the rest. Meet Goldman!
